name: Liferun
verdict: Liferun generated 138 leads over 28 days at a $15.80 CPL across $2,181 in spend, with Meta carrying the full lead load (138 leads, $1,672.27 spend) while Google Ads produced zero conversions from $508.73 and 115 clicks. The biggest movement is a 46.15% drop in GBP actions week-over-week, likely driven by reduced local search visibility or seasonal intent decline, while the lead count shows a mild discrepancy between reporting sources (138 via channel data vs. 134 opportunities in GHL) that are unreconciled.

performance.verdict: Meta CPL is efficient but Google's $509 zero-conversion spend is an active cash drain.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $508.73 over 28 days with 0 conversions and 115 clicks — confirmed spend with zero lead return.
5 overdue milestones unconfirmed (oldest Jul 20): Stripe QA, GHL gaps, stack re-test, landing pages, UGC batch — all blocking scale.
Meta is dark on weekends: 0 spend and 0 leads on Sat/Sun across all 4 sampled weekends — structural schedule gap, not seasonal.
3-day lead signal (Sep 11–13): 4+0+0=4 leads vs prior 3 days (Sep 8–10): 10+12+6=28 — a 86% drop as weekend zeros dominate.
GHL shows 134 opportunities vs 138 channel leads and 0 appointments won — 4-lead intake gap and zero pipeline conversion in 28 days.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads immediately: $508.73 spent, 0 conversions, 0 leads in 28 days — confirmed zero-return channel.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $508.73 over 28 days and produced zero conversions and zero leads across 115 clicks. Pause all Google Ads campaigns now to stop the bleed. Success check: zero Google Ads spend by Sep 15; redirect the ~$18/day to Meta or hold for landing page launch (F2). Re-evaluate Google only after paid landing pages are live (SOW milestone, overdue Aug 31).

suggestions.text: Enable Meta weekend scheduling: 0 spend and 0 leads every Saturday/Sunday across 4 consecutive weekends — fix ad schedule.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend drops to exactly $0 every Saturday and Sunday across all 4 sampled weekends, costing an estimated 8 lead-days per month at the current $15.80 CPL. Check the campaign ad schedule in Meta Ads Manager and confirm weekends are not manually excluded; if budget exhaustion is causing it, redistribute daily budget or switch to lifetime budget with even delivery. Success check: Meta records non-zero spend on both Sep 20–21 weekend days. Re-check Sep 22.

suggestions.text: Watch GHL pipeline: 134 opps, 0 won, 0 appointments in 28 days — confirm intake flow before acting on volume.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 134 opportunities created but zero won and zero appointments booked in the 28-day window, alongside 5 overdue SOW milestones including the stack re-test. Do not scale lead volume until the intake and Becklar/BWS paths are verified end-to-end (per SOW). Success check: at least 1 confirmed won opportunity and the stack re-test completed. Re-check Sep 21.
